comment: Machine-independent perf gate. Each check is the throughput ratio of a motif bench to a baseline bench measured WITHIN a single run, so it is stable across CI runners (absolute hz is not). Budgets sit well below observed local ratios to absorb runner variance and sampling noise; a breach means motif regressed or the baseline closed the gap — investigate, do not blindly rebaseline. Reproduce with `yarn bench:check`. Run `yarn bench:check --update` to print the freshly observed ratios for a considered rebaseline.
